title: Ali Wong: Baby Cobra
overview: Ali Wong might be seven-months pregnant, but there’s not a fetus in the world that can stop this acerbic and savage train of comedy from delivering a masterful hour of stand-up.

title: Ali Wong: Don Wong
overview: In her third Netflix stand-up special, Ali Wong reveals her wildest fantasies, the challenges of monogamy and how she really feels about single people.

title: Amy Schumer: The Leather Special
overview: Comic sensation Amy Schumer riffs on sex, dating and the absurdities of fame in a bold and uncensored stand-up set at Denver's Bellco Theater.

title: Chappelle's Home Team - Luenell: Town Business
overview: Fasten your seatbelts as Luenell sounds off on bad seatmates, first-class feuds, sockless babies and more travel mishaps in this brash stand-up special.

title: Chelsea Handler: Revolution
overview: Chelsea Handler lets loose on her life choices, rowdy rescue dogs, dating frustrations, and why society owes women an apology.

title: Chelsea Handler: The Feeling
overview: From ruining Thanksgiving to a wild summer fling, Chelsea Handler recounts coming of age, unexpected encounters and that time she met Bill Cosby.

title: Chelsea Handler: Uganda Be Kidding Me Live
overview: A culmination of Chelsea Handler's stand-up comedy tour in support of her fourth New York Times #1 Bestseller, Uganda Be Kidding Me.

title: Christina P: Mom Genes
overview: Comedian Christina P examines the joys and drags of parenting, partnering and more through a no-nonsense Gen-X lens in this special.

title: Christina P: Mother Inferior
overview: Christina Pazsitzky hits Seattle with a biting dose of reality, telling truths about her childhood, getting older and the horrors of giving birth.

title: Hazel Brugger: Tropical
overview: In this stand-up special, comedian Hazel Brugger offers her breezy takes on unruly geese, chatty gynecologists, German bank loans and more.

title: Iliza Shlesinger: Confirmed Kills
overview: The standup sensation tackle's TV's "Shark Tank," what it means to be a woman and how to deal with the lawless party goblin that lives in us all.

title: Iliza Shlesinger: Elder Millennial
overview: Filmed February 23, 2018, aboard the USS Hornet, comedian Iliza Shlesinger brings an ‘elder millennial’ perspective to her audience. Recently engaged, she dives into undeniable truths about life at age 35. Looking back at the insanity of the road traveled and what’s to come, Iliza talks first apartments, a woman's inner she dragon, peacock mating calls, and her newfound urge to squeeze a chubby baby leg.

title: Iliza Shlesinger: Freezing Hot
overview: Smart and brazen comedian Iliza Shlesinger shares her unflinchingly honest observations on the differences between men and women. Filled with hashtag-able catch phrases, this is a laugh-out-loud revelation exposing some of women’s best kept - and ugliest - secrets, including truths about first date attire, fantasy break-ups and the tireless pursuit of not being cold while still looking hot.

title: Iliza Shlesinger: Hot Forever
overview: Iliza Shlesinger talks about different topics. She starts from every girl's ugly bra to how all adult men need to own a box spring.

title: Iliza Shlesinger: Unveiled
overview: Comedian Iliza Shlesinger dissects her recent wedding with riffs on screeching bachelorette parties, that creepy garter removal tradition and more.

title: Jen Kirkman: Just Keep Livin'?
overview: Incisive comic Jen Kirkman gets real about women's bodies, the value of alone time and an Italian private tour guide who may have been a ghost.

title: Katherine Ryan: Glitter Room
overview: Fresh from a tour, comedian Katherine Ryan shares shrewd observations about school bullies, revenge bodies and raising a very fancy child.

title: Katherine Ryan: In Trouble
overview: Stand-up comic Katherine Ryan reminisces about unusual relationships, aging, Taylor Swift, life in the hometown she hates and the time she enraged an entire nation.

title: Kathleen Madigan: Bothering Jesus
overview: Kathleen Madigan's stand up special.

title: Leslie Jones: Time Machine
overview: From trying to seduce Prince to battling sleep apnea, Leslie Jones traces her evolution as an adult in a joyfully raw and outrageous stand-up special.

title: Lynne Koplitz: Hormonal Beast
overview: Unabashed comedian Lynne Koplitz offers a woman's take on being crazy, the benefits of childlessness and the three things all men really want.

title: Alexis de Anda: Mea Culpa
overview: Stand-up comedian Alexis de Anda shares thoughts on gynecologists, drugs, and sex.

title: Michelle Wolf: Joke Show
overview: Comedian Michelle Wolf takes on outrage culture, massages, childbirth, feminism and much more (like otters) in a stand-up special from New York City.

title: Michelle Wolf: The Well
overview: Michelle Wolf gets real about white women, serial killers and adjusting to motherhood in this sharp, unfiltered stand-up special.

title: Miranda Sings Live... Your Welcome
overview: Viral video star Miranda Sings and her real-world alter ego Colleen Ballinger share the stage in a special packed with music, comedy and "magichinry."

title: Ms. Pat: Y'all Wanna Hear Something Crazy?
overview: Ms. Pat finds laughter in the absurdities of parenting, pet lovers and very unfortunate lip trends as she unpacks a painful past with humor and honesty.

title: My Name Is Mo'Nique
overview: You think you know Mo'Nique? From staring down a racist teacher to her grandmother's sex warning, she spills all in this stand-up comedy special.

title: Natalia Valdebenito: El especial
overview: A Chilean comedian fuses activism with irreverence for a stand-up set filled with jokes about misogyny, reproductive rights and respecting women.

title: Park Na-rae: Glamour Warning
overview: Korea's beloved comedian and favorite big sister figure talks sex, relationships and celebrity life. And she's sassier and dirtier than ever before.

title: Sofía Niño de Rivera: Natural Selection
overview: If it were up to this Mexican comedian, marriage proposals would occur in the middle of a couple's biggest argument.

title: Sommore: Chandelier Fly
overview: Get ready for comedic royalty as the Undisputed Queen of Comedy, Sommore, returns to Detroit for her 7th special, performing up close and personal at the Garden Theatre, recorded on June 28th.

title: Sommore: Queen Chandelier
overview: This Queen of Comedy shines as she takes the stage to sound off on her suspicion of free stuff, social media prayer requests, fake lashes and ugly shoes.

title: Taylor Tomlinson: Have It All
overview: Can Taylor Tomlinson have it all? From dating woes to dream jobs to inventive dirty talk, she shares life's ups and downs in this stand-up comedy special.

title: Taylor Tomlinson: Quarter-Life Crisis
overview: Comedian Taylor Tomlinson is halfway through her 20s — and she's over it. From dating losers to a failed engagement, she takes aim at her life choices.

title: Tiffany Haddish Presents: They Ready
overview: Tiffany Haddish introduces her favorite comedians in a series of stand-up performances.

title: Tiffany Haddish: Black Mitzvah
overview: On her 40th birthday, Tiffany Haddish drops a bombastic special studded with singing, dancing and raunchy reflections on her long road to womanhood.

title: Tig
overview: An intimate documentary that follows Tig Notaro, a Los Angeles based comedian, who just days after being diagnosed with invasive stage II breast cancer changed the course of her career with a poignant stand-up set that became legendary overnight. It explores Tig's extraordinary journey as her career ignites and as her life unfolds in grand and unexpected ways, all the while continuing to battle a life-threatening illness and falling in love.

title: Urzila Carlson: Overqualified Loser
overview: Stand-up comedian Urzila Carlson keeps the crowd roaring with her thoughts on recasting "The Biggest Loser," sex tape regrets and boxed wine hangovers.

title: Wanda Sykes: Not Normal
overview: Wanda Sykes tackles politics, reality TV, racism and the secret she'd take to the grave in this rollicking, no-holds-barred stand-up special.

title: Ali Wong: Hard Knock Wife
overview: Pregnant again, Ali Wong returns to Netflix in her second original stand-up comedy special and gets real on why having kids is not all it's cracked up to be.

title: Ali Wong: Single Lady
overview: After a whirlwind couple of years, Ali Wong returns to the stage to dish on the highs, lows and surprises of dating post-divorce.

title: Cristela Alonzo: Lower Classy
overview: The irrepressible Alonzo skewers Latino stereotypes, pricey luxuries and her mother's tough-love parenting in a night of sly and infectious comedy.

title: Malena Pichot: Estupidez compleja
overview: This funnywoman champions feminism while explaining while walking down the street eating a banana is an extreme sport.

title: Michela Giraud: The Truth, I Swear!
overview: From the stage of Vinile, in Rome, rigorously standing up alone in front of her audience, Michela Giraud tells her own truth through the strong and self-deprecating point of view that has always distinguished her.

title: Wanda Sykes: I'm an Entertainer
overview: The comedy icon sounds off on parenting with her French wife, the perils of public bathrooms and why she's tired of going high when others go low.
